_about: The model and reasoning effort each kind of session gets, chosen by the ticket's Kind line. A session runs until its work is done, with no checkpoints.

trivial.for: file a document, update a page, move or rename files; no code, no decision

mechanical.for: a test-only or one-line fix, a run sheet followed step by step, a read-only count

build.for: a feature or fix with tests seen failing first, a stuck bug, a measured AI-quality iteration, a production-write tool; the coordinating session of a night sitting

deep.for: planning, architecture and schema design, legal or terms analysis, a risky review; plans and reviews, never builds
